verdict.rationale: Treg is API-first: one base URL and token expose 159 documented operations plus a `/call/` proxy to 3,800+ provider endpoints. Documented endpoints include `/catalog/search` and `/catalog/platforms/{slug}`, and every catalogued endpoint lists its price, parameters and an example response. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, and llms.txt teaches the protocol to agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of successfully driving the API end-to-end (the community only describes it as a set of stateless APIs).
